rationale: Price gapped up 12.5% and has already pulled back significantly from the session high of $15.53 to $13.82, sitting at only 29% of today's range and below both VWAP ($14.54) and the 9-EMA ($13.95), indicating sustained selling pressure. A short entry is equally unattractive given the stock remains well above prior close and could see late-day short-covering with 86 minutes remaining; the risk/reward in either direction is unclear.
